mapper.sql: a.id, a.aftersales_no, a.type, a.reason_code, a.quantity, a.description, a.status, a.return_guidance, a.consumer_parcel_no, a.refund_amount, a.resend_tracking_no, a.final_note, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.closed_at, a.order_item_id, a.consumer_user_id, oi.product_name, oi.color, oi.size, oi.quantity as item_quantity, oi.unit_price, o.order_no, o.completed_at as order_completed_at, date_add(o.completed_at, interval o.after_sale_days day) as after_sale_deadline, u.display_name as consumer_name
from aftersales_order a join order_item oi on oi.id = a.order_item_id join shop_order o on o.id = oi.order_id join app_user u on u.id = a.consumer_user_id
mapper.insert: insert into aftersales_order (aftersales_no, order_item_id, consumer_user_id, type, reason_code, quantity, description, status, created_at) values (#{aftersalesNo}, #{orderItemId}, #{consumerUserId}, #{type}, #{reasonCode}, #{quantity}, #{description}, #{status}, now())
mapper.update: update aftersales_order set aftersales_no = #{no} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, aftersales_no, order_item_id, consumer_user_id, type, reason_code, quantity, description, status, return_guidance, consumer_parcel_no, refund_amount, resend_tracking_no, final_note, created_at, updated_at, closed_at from aftersales_order where id = #{id}

select
and a.status = #{status} and a.type = #{type}
and (a.aftersales_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.order_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or oi.product_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.display_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by a.id desc limit 100
select status, count(*) as count from aftersales_order group by status
select ifnull(sum(quantity), 0) from aftersales_order where order_item_id = #{itemId} and status not in ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')
select count(*) from aftersales_order where order_item_id = #{itemId} and status not in ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED')
